title: Generalized Fallback Installers — ecosystem routes when no native package manager covers the OS
scope: Declarative `fallback: { go|npm|cargo|uv: "<first-party pkg>" }` slot on define_tool!. Platform slots always win; on is_no_platform_installer() the runtime takes fallback routes in declared order, auto-installing the missing ecosystem toolchain through jarvy's own registry (go/nvm+node/rustup/uv all have first-party routes) before running the route. Python route is `uv tool install` (isolated, no PEP-668 issues), NOT pip. HARD REQUIREMENT: ecosystem package managers only — no curl|sh fallbacks ever. Package strings pass validate_package_name. Install receipts (~/.jarvy/install-receipts.json, doctor-cache-style stat signature for staleness) route fallback-installed tools to the right check-updates probe and make receipt-aware `jarvy upgrade` work. tool.installed gains install_route + toolchain_bootstrapped; tool.unsupported fires only when all routes exhausted. betterleaks is the first consumer (deletes its bespoke custom_install, 4cadf92); ~20 'no first-party winget manifest' tools are migration candidates. Full PRD: tasks/prd-060-fallback-installers.md
